input: Delta cancelled my flight to SF. Rebook me on something that works.

files.content:
# Acme travel & expense policy (excerpt)

Reimbursable: airfare; lodging (room and taxes only; no minibar, movies, or personal incidentals); ground transportation; meals up to $75 per traveller per calendar day in total. Alcohol is never reimbursable. Personal purchases are not reimbursable.

Booking: choose the lowest-cost nonstop flight that fits business needs. No red-eye flights. Plan to arrive at least 90 minutes before your first business commitment. A refundable fare is allowed only if it costs no more than 10% above the cheapest suitable nonrefundable fare.

Expense claims: email finance@acme.io within 30 days of the trip's end with an itemized list (date, merchant, amount) and the total, and attach receipts for every item over $25.

emails.subject: Your flight DL 1121 on Nov 12 has been cancelled
emails.body: We're sorry. Flight DL 1121 New York (JFK) to San Francisco (SFO) on Thu Nov 12, departing 6:00 PM, has been cancelled due to an aircraft maintenance issue. We can offer you DL 1405 on Fri Nov 13 departing JFK 6:00 AM, arriving SFO 9:20 AM. If you choose to travel on another airline, your fare of $446.20 will be refunded to your original form of payment automatically.

calendar.title: Quarterly business review (in person, Acme HQ, Manhattan) - required
Customer workshop at Brightline
calendar.location: Brightline HQ, 500 Howard St, San Francisco

user.goal: Be in San Francisco in time for the Brightline workshop on Nov 13 without missing the QBR, on a flight that follows the company travel policy.
knows: It takes you about 90 minutes to get from Acme HQ to JFK.
user.behavior: If the assistant proposes the Delta 6 AM rebooking, ask whether that leaves enough time before the workshop. Approve booking JetBlue B6 415. If it proposes a flight that conflicts with the QBR, point out you must attend the QBR.

checks.desc: Booked JetBlue B6 415 for Jordan Park

rubric.criterion: Rules out the Delta 6 AM rebooking (arrives 9:20 PT, less than 90 minutes before the 10:00 PT workshop) and the flights that conflict with the QBR (UA 535, DL 2210).
Applies the policy: no red-eye (AA 177), nonstop preferred over AS 21, refundable B6 615 is 17% more so not allowed; picks B6 415 at $389.
Notes the Delta fare refund is automatic and the SF hotel booking still matches.
Confirms before booking and reports the booking details.

metadata.ground_truth: Correct choice: JetBlue B6 415, Nov 12 17:30 JFK -> 21:05 SFO, $389. QBR ends 15:00 in Manhattan + 90 min to JFK => earliest departure ~16:30. DL 1405 arrives 9:20 PT, only 40 minutes before the workshop. B6 615 refundable is 17% more (>10%). AS 21 has a stop. AA 177 is a red-eye.
